exact_statement: For any Boolean g(a),h(b) on disjoint uniform private cubes and a fresh physical selector z, supplied normalized spectral references can be empty-calibrated without increasing CE. For F=z?g:h the complete coherent reference in DERIVATION.md has CE_F=(CE_g_cal+CE_h_cal)/2+Delta(mu,nu), debt=(D_g_cal+D_h_cal)/2, and Delta<=(6+1/ln2)Inf_z<(15/2)Inf_z when Inf_z>0. I_data=[I(g)+I(h)]/2 and Inf_z=(1-mu*nu)/2. Two opposite shared-literal activations with disjoint private supports therefore retain half their respective weighted terminal costs and pay each physical influence once. The recursive literal/constant certificate closed under sign flips, disjoint products, fresh activation and fresh-selector disjoint-child mux has an explicit normalized calibrated output reference with CE<=(15/2)I and is hereditary under physical restrictions. For every Boolean seed f, membership of f, its fresh balanced disjoint tensor, and a fresh point activation of that tensor is equivalent. No arbitrary opaque terminal admission, general selector substitution, additional shared-private-coordinate payment, optimal constant or universal FEI is asserted.

exact_statement: For every Boolean f and every order sigma, normalize Q_(sigma,k)(S)=prod_{i in positions_sigma(S)}i^(-2)/Z_(n,k), set beta_(n,k)=ln(Z_(n,k)(k!)^2), D_sigma=sum_k P(|S|=k)D_nat(P(S||S|=k)||Q_(sigma,k)), and T_sigma=2R_sigma-D_sigma. Then (ln2)H(f)=H_nat(|S|)+T_sigma+E beta, with 0<=beta_(n,k)<=k ln(pi^2/4). If K_T=sup_nonconstant_f min_sigma T_sigma/I(f) and C_FEI=sup H/I, then K_T/ln2<=C_FEI<=log2(4+e)+log2(pi^2/4)+K_T/ln2 in the extended real sense. Thus K_T finite iff uniform-cube FEI holds. Concrete paid application: for any Boolean g with known bias mu and supplied normalized core reference R positive on its spectrum, empty calibration to R0(empty)=mu^2 is CE-nonincreasing. For r>=1,p=2^-r,F=1+A_r(g-1), the full reference Q(vac)=[1-p(1-mu)]^2, Q(U!=empty,T=empty)=p^2(1-mu)^2, Q(U,T!=empty)=p^2 R0(T) is normalized and has CE_F-H(F)=p D(P_g||R0) and CE_F<=p CE_g_cal+6rp(1-mu). For g=q product_j(1-2 A_(L_j)) on disjoint private blocks and a supplied terminal reference, its fixed occupied-block/uniform-nonempty-subset reference gives CE_F<=p CE_q_cal+4p sum_j I(h_j)+6rp(1-mu_g), with I(F)=p[I(q)+sum_j I(h_j)+r(1-mu_g)]. Thus a terminal cost <=C I(q) yields full cost <=max(C,6)I(F); q=1 yields CE<=6I uniformly in r, widths and number of blocks. For r=0,q=1 the same block reference has CE=H<4I. No universal terminal reference bound or incompatible shared-control extension is claimed.

k=0 reference assigns mass one to empty set
References normalized and positive on actual support
Shared controls form one common signed conjunction; all remaining private blocks and terminal cube are disjoint

Ideal negative-log probability costs; no optional binary prefix-rounding bit included
